notes:
A big release focused on safer saves, faster and more reliable checkpoints, and a refreshed interface built on Palette's design system.

### New

- **Fable model** — pick Fable alongside the other Claude Code models in the model picker.
- **Markdown frontmatter in the viewer** — documents with frontmatter now show it as a compact summary instead of raw text.
- **Viewer close button** — close the viewer straight from its header.
- **Update-in-place share links** — reshare a session to the same link, with a clearer indication of what's currently shared.
- **Installed skills everywhere** — every lane now lists your installed skills right away, along with where each one came from.
- **Higher session and chat limits** — early-access accounts can keep more sessions and chats going at once.

### Improved

- **Refreshed look and feel** — dialogs, tooltips, toasts, file trees, page headers, and the workspace shell all moved onto Palette's shared design system for a more consistent interface.
- **Faster session creation** — cloud folders are warmed up in parallel, so new sessions start noticeably sooner.
- **Safer saves** — saving now applies only your session's changes and snapshots your Home folder first, so nothing gets overwritten.
- **Steadier cloud folders** — Palette detects changes with a live folder watcher, self-heals temporary cloud-sync failures when creating a session, backs off when a folder is unreachable, and keeps simultaneous changes from colliding.
- **Cleaner checkpoints** — system metadata files are no longer swept into your snapshots.

### Fixed

- **Stuck sessions** — a rare timing issue could leave a session permanently wedged; it now recovers on its own.
- **Saves with images and other binaries** — conflicting binary files are resolved instead of failing the whole save.
- **Snapshots on removed sessions** — deleting a session mid-snapshot no longer surfaces an error.
